A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a new clustering method that is robust to noise and outliers.
CIFs are the right tool to use for density-based clustering in high dimensional data.
we have introduced the notion of Cluster Intensity Function, which captures the important properties of clusters.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the CIFs provide a simple, yet powerful, way of capturing the important characteristics of data clusters and thus provide an intuitive way of clustering.
CIFs are a powerful tool for clustering and density-based clustering can benefit from the use of these CIFs.
CIFs are more robust and accurate than density functions in revealing clusters and their characteristics.
